functions.behavior: Capture file slot GPR4. Read global archive-mode word before conditional low-level close(slot+4). After that call, freshly reload wrapping32 open-count, decrement/store, then clear slot words in observed +18,+0,+4,+8,+C,+14 order; +10 is untouched. All sixteen actual encoded callers discard or overwrite incidental V0 in the manually checked paths; a proposed void interface models effects without claiming the original source return type. No owner/count/null guards.
implementation_limits: Only slot seven-word prefix and map pointer at context+0x50 are observed. No class, vtable, allocation size/capacity, archive format or resource ownership inferred.
Count is wrapping32 and freshly read after close; mode is tested before call. Slot clears+18,+0,+4,+8,+C,+14; +10 remains as last external callback left it. No owner/count/null guards added.

Archive scratch64 is uninitialized in production. Fixtures use nonempty ASCII input, valid colon scans, terminated resolved strings shorter than64, initialized aligned readable string lanes and nonoverlapping copies. Original unbounded/prior-stack/optimized-read/invalid-pointer behavior and safe capacities unclaimed.

Marker search is substring-based; first located seven-byte cdrom0: is skipped, including empty suffix. CRC length/bytes and map key are full32; positive eight-bucket maps include collisions and missing full keys. Context map pointer is loaded after CRC, and allocator hook can mutate it during lazy resolver setup.

Cache/SDK close/core allocation/diagnostic hooks model only arguments, ignored returns and explicitly authored state mutations. No SDK, OS, kernel, heap algorithm, concurrency, exception, EE upper-register/FCR/timing fidelity claimed.

Full selected/actual helper instructions execute strict initialized owned memory with actual JR31/terminal, taken and untaken delay guards, annul semantics and unsupported-opcode rejection. Supporting readonly table/constants receive identity evidence only, no code/data credit.

Native executes exact complete lexical production spans and actual complete macro invocations in separate TUs after preserving genuine old-MinGW whole-TU unresolved failure. No fabricated support globals/functions; complete span/source/generated-TU hashes and actual compiler closures prove reuse.

Generic unchanged public Newlib strings use PREFER_SIZE_OVER_SPEED and transparent numeric bridges; they validate the supported byte semantics rather than retail optimized source identity. Public ctype/strlwr/tolower/strstr and real project CRC/length/map run; no additional recovered helper award.

Six genuine complete natural target links and four whole authentic ABI calls use canonical bindings only. All are compared at original address/full symbol extent with zero relocations/extra allocated sections and no patches, masks, crops or mapping. Both selected entries remain reconstructed/nonexact.
